summary: Regression-tested FocusOne backend and mobile web UI. Core API CRUD/parser passed; auth screen and account creation reached Today dashboard. UI run progressed through task, planning, focus, and review flows, but one later assertion failed without a captured message.
action_items: Re-run the full UI flow with a more granular assertion log to isolate the inconclusive late-flow failure.
critical_code_review_comments: Focus completion logging is only exercised when the timer reaches zero, so the UI start/pause check does not verify POST /api/focus/log integration.
seed_data_creation: Created unique TEST/UI accounts and records through public APIs; no seeded credentials changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials guidance says create a unique example.com account. Public URL is https://study-planner-838.preview.emergentagent.com. First UI attempt mistakenly submitted sign-in; corrected attempt created an account and reached dashboard, then progressed to Review before an assertion failure with empty message.
rca_of_issue: The first apparent auth failure was test setup, not app behavior: the script did not switch from Sign in to Create account. The corrected script authenticated successfully. The second run's empty assertion requires granular rerun; no confirmed product defect was isolated.
